text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was already time for our meeting, but 
Mayano Top Gun still hadn't shown up...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yaho-yaho~! Trainer-chan, did you wait 
long~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah☆ That almost felt like a date just 
now!? Eeeeek~~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Not that! Sorry, Trainer-chan! My 
classmates cornered me~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: *sigh* Tests start tomorrow, huh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
So depressing~. Maybe I should just take 
the day off?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! Maya totally hates tests 
too~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I finished it so fast, but I'm not allowed 
to sleep or play! Jeez, all I can do is 
draw pictures~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Maya, oh you silly girl~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice~. You're gonna just 'know' 
all the answers on the next test too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maya! Tell us what's gonna be on the 
test!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Maya, pleeease! Do it as a favor to a 
friend! Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆ Leave everything to yours 
truly, Maya♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And like that, I taught them what I knew! 
Everyone was super happy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"He said, ‘Looking forward to working with 
you next time too!’ Ehehe, it's tough 
being such a popular woman~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is in high spirits, but as 
her Trainer, I'm a little worried whether 
it might put too much of a burden on 
her...
choice_data_list: Why don't you let Mayano thank you too?

If you don't like something, you have to 
say no, okay?

If you don't like something, just say no, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is in high spirits, but as 
her Trainer, I'm a little worried whether 
it might put too much of a burden on 
her...
choice_data_list: Why don't you let Mayano thank you too?

If you don't like something, you have to 
say no, okay?

If you don't like something, just say no, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that offering a reward in 
addition to teaching would lighten the 
burden, I made the proposal, and—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aaaah!! Maya totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A reward, huh~♪ What should I ask for~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! I'll get them to hang out with 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nobody would hang out with me during exam 
week 'cause they all had to study~
choice_data_list:
Thanks to Mayano, I've got some free time 
now.

Thanks to Mayano, I've got some free time 
now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! I'll ask tomorrow~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: A thank-you gift for Maya?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yup! I want you to play with Maya♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Lately, everyone's been so busy studying 
for tests that no one has time to hang out 
with me~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The so-called "Maya's Boot Camp"... 
Basically, it means I just have to play my 
heart out with you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good. I was hoping to take a 
breather anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Me too! Bring on the boot camp♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yayyyyyy! Let's play to our hearts' 
content!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Mayano Top Gun played 
right up to curfew and returned in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez! You're such a worrywart, 
Trainer-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's happy to be relied on, and 
everyone's happy understanding their 
studies!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: See? It's full of good things♪
choice_data_list: Then I want you to make me happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay! Tell me anything♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having secured her promise, I decided to 
put Mayano Top Gun through some intensive 
training.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Maya is soooo nooooot happy with 
this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Uuu! Trainer-chan, you're so mean...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, good job today, Maya!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer really knows their stuff! 
They totally understand how to handle 
Maya.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Trainer-chan really is 
amazing♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you pick one: sulking or being 
happy?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-That's just the complex heart of a 
maiden~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through that bitter experience, Mayano Top 
Gun seems to have become a slightly wiser 
woman.
